inputs.text: Photorealistic documentary footage of an ordinary outdoor concrete-paver sidewalk beside an existing shallow inspection trench. Locked tripod, natural overcast daylight, realistic full scale and granular textures. A continuous field of many individual weathered gray rectangular pavers, thin sand bedding, compacted crushed aggregate and brown soil form one connected construction. The camera and surroundings stay fixed. First hold still; then a small area of the paved surface slowly settles down together while each concrete paver remains rigid and recognizable; finally the movement stops. No cause is shown or claimed. Camera at a three-quarter oblique angle, looking across the top of the sidewalk and down the exposed side of the trench at the same time. Top joints, thin sand and aggregate below the pavers are visible together. Earth continues beyond the frame; this is not a freestanding block.
